kicker: NONE OF THEM ARE ABOUT MONEY
title: 10 reasons people *don't respect you*

items.head: Yes to every favor
items.sub: If you never say no, your yes is worth nothing.

items.head: 10 minutes late, every time
items.sub: Small broken promises say your word is cheap.

items.head: Explaining every decision
items.sub: "I'm not coming." Full stop. No 3-paragraph reason.

items.head: Complaining out loud
items.sub: Nobody follows the guy who narrates his bad day.

label: REASON 9
head: You let your body go
sub: People read your discipline before you say a word.

head: Reason 10: the group disagrees
r: "I still think it's a bad deal. Here's why."

text: Respect isn't asked for. It's what shows up when *you stop chasing approval.*

head: Fix *one* this week
sub: Send it to the friend who says sorry for everything.
